The '''Wayfar Medical Center''' was a small [[Medcenter/Legends|hospital]] in the desert town of [[Wayfar/Legends|Wayfar]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Description==
[[File:Wayfar_medical_center_interior.jpg|thumb|left|Inside the Medical Center.]]
It was a small sand-[[Color/Legends|colored]] building on the edge of the town with three floors, two of them below ground. The first floor was taken up by a lounge area with chairs and [[Couch/Legends|couches]], as well as a smaller medical area with beds for several patients, medical equipment, [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] containers and a [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droid]].

Stairs led down to the lower floors. Most of the rooms below ground were unused as of [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. One room was used as a living room, with potted plants, chairs, lamps and cabinets.

Inexperienced [[Medic/Legends|medics]] would often seek out this facility to learn the necessary skills of their profession from experienced [[Doctor/Legends|doctors]] and combat medics.

==Behind the scenes==
This medical center is a building in [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. It is not part of any quest in the game. In the early years of the game, players of the medic and doctor professions could heal other players' wounds in these buildings. Just being inside such a building would also slowly heal the player's wounds over time.

Before the Doctor and Combat Medic professions were removed from the game in 2005, trainer NPCs in the Medical Center could also teach players of these professions new skills.
